articles.author: Rusil Koirala
articles.description:
This is a submission for the DEV April Fools Challenge
Ever felt overwhelmed by productivity apps telling you to wake up at 5 AM, drink green juice, and conquer the world before breakfast?
Same.
So I built ProcrastiNation, a revolutionary productivity tool designed to ensure you never get anything done. It looks sleek, sounds intelligent and behaves like a serious piece of software but beneath the surface it is expertly engineered to waste your time.
This app solves absolutely nothing and it does so beautifully.
procrastinationn.vercel.app
          

        
      
 / 
        ProcrastiNation
      
    
🚀 ProcrastiNation — The Ultimate Productivity Killer
Welcome to the cutting edge of professional idleness. ProcrastiNation is an enterprise-grade web application engineered entirely in Next.js to do exactly one thing: absolutely nothing.
Through state-of-the-art Neobrutalism UI and complex reverse-productivity algorithms, this app ensures you maintain the aesthetic of a hyper-focused tech worker while getting absolutely zero work done.

🔮 Core Features
The Infinite Start Button
AI Excuse Generator (ProcrastiAI™ v0.0.1-beta)
copy-to-clipboard integration for immediate deployment.
Broken Pomodoro Timer
View on GitHub
I built this project using the latest version of Next.js why not :) with the App Router. The UI was created with shadcn/ui and styled using Tailwind CSS with a neobrutalism-inspired design. I used the Space Grotesk font because it looks good (what did you expect?). 
I’m submitting this for the Community Favorite category because it’s simple, fun, and something most people can relate to. The idea of a productivity app that actually makes you less productive is something everyone understands, and I wanted to make something people can interact with and laugh at.
Built and submitted by me @rusilkoirala 
No team, just procrastination.
articles.title: Finally a productivity app that understands you

articles.author: Brian Paget
articles.description:
Every major AI chat platform today requires you to create an account. Your conversations are stored, analyzed, and often used for model training. For many people, this is a dealbreaker — especially when asking sensitive questions about health, legal matters, or personal issues.
That's why I built GPTAnon — a free, privacy-first AI chat platform where you can talk to top AI models completely anonymously.
Want to ask ChatGPT a question? Create an account. Claude? Account. Gemini? Account. Every platform ties your identity to your conversations, creating a permanent record of your most private thoughts and questions.
I kept thinking: why does asking an AI a question require surrendering your privacy?
GPTAnon flips the script:
No account required — just open the site and start chatting
No conversation logs — your chats aren't stored on any server
No tracking — no analytics cookies, no fingerprinting, no behavioral tracking
Multiple AI models — compare responses from GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and more side by side
100% free — privacy shouldn't be a premium feature
Privacy isn't just for people with something to hide. It's for:
The person researching a medical condition they're not ready to discuss
The employee exploring whether their workplace situation is legal
The student who wants to ask "dumb questions" without judgment
Anyone who simply believes their conversations are nobody else's business
Head over to gptanon.com and start chatting — no signup required. I'd love to hear what you think.
If you find it useful, consider sharing it with others who value their privacy. And feel free to drop feedback in the comments — I'm actively building new features based on user input.
Follow the project on X: @chatordieai
articles.title: I Built an Anonymous AI Chat Platform — No Login, No Tracking, No Logs
